# Calendar 1.4.0 — local AI update

- Prefer **Qwen3.5 0.8B Q4_K_M**, downloaded separately with explicit consent. Keep the last manually selected model across restarts. **LFM2.5 350M Q4_K_M remains bundled** for offline use immediately after installation. Optional IQ4_XS and LFM2.5 2.6B remain available.
- Separate verified disk installation from RAM residency. Reload existing weights after memory release, recover OPFS registrations, retain valid weights after cancellation, and report actual storage/loading errors.
- Import supported GGUF files on Android through the system Storage Access Framework. Stream content URIs to OPFS, verify size and SHA-256, and commit installation metadata only after successful storage. Desktop/web retain local file import. Arbitrary GGUF models are not supported.
- Refresh AI settings with an active-model card, real disk/RAM badges, download/import/diagnostics actions and individual model cards. Use all seven themes and custom palettes. Bundled APK weights cannot be deleted.
- Add six framed header controls, including quick switching between installed models and assistant minimization. Keep drafts, scroll position, history and in-progress responses when minimized. The optional background setting continues responses while using the calendar; it does **not** provide an Android foreground service. Leaving the app may stop generation, and killing the process stops it.
- Preserve local conversation history, new chats, JSON import/export and model identity. Restored history cannot replay calendar actions.
- Improve named event titles, explicit time ranges, conversational prefixes and time clarification. Require confirmation for calendar mutations; show success only after the database write completes.
- Keep quick/rules/model diagnostics, actual model and quantization, load state and native timings. Existing comparison reports remain available; small local models can still misunderstand language, dates and arithmetic. Review every proposed change.

## Installation and data

Use the package for your platform. Android uses application ID `com.kalendarz.offline` and must match the permanent 1.3.1 signing certificate. Install the official APK over official 1.3.1; **do not uninstall or clear application data**. Export a calendar backup before updating your primary calendar. Separate `.diagnostics` builds are not production updates.

Only the verified 350M model is bundled; Qwen adds about 528 MB of device storage after download and needs about 1.6 GB of RAM. Initial Web/PWA installation transfers the bundled weights; wait for offline installation before disconnecting. Device storage eviction or clearing browser data can remove downloaded models.

Release checks cover TypeScript, unit tests, calendar persistence, conversation history, bounded real Qwen/350M inference, packaged desktop applications, Android URI streaming and an in-place emulator update from official 1.3.1. The final validation report records actual outcomes. This release does not claim physical POCO X7 Pro validation of this exact build, guaranteed response times or full Android background generation. Windows executables are not Authenticode-signed.
